sentences.text: Amalendu Jana vs Unknown on 10 September, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
10.09.2024
 Sl No.53
Court No.29
 (gc)
 Crm (A) 3204 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in  connection with Junput Coastal Police Station Case No.130 of  2024 dated 11.06.2024 under Sections 498A/306/34 of the  Indian Penal Code.
And  In the matter of : Amalendu Jana  - Petitioner.

Mr. Navanil De,
 Ms. Shoumilya Mazumder

Mr. Bidyut Kumar Ray,
 Mr. Shiladitya Banerjee  ... For the State.

1. 
In view of the submission on behalf of the State that in the final report culminating the charge-sheet the petitioner has not been named, this application is disposed of by recording the aforesaid fact and taking on record the memo of evidence filed on behalf of the State.
2. Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
3. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Prasenjit Biswas, J.)
